name: websurf-game
description: WebSurf 最小化实现：BSP 解析（WASM）+ Rust 物理（WASM）+ 主线程唯一物理渲染线 + 单 Worker 权威帧 + Three.js 渲染。

scripts.build:wasm: cd crates/wasm && wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir ../../pkg && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('../../pkg/websurf_wasm_bg.wasm','../../web/websurf_wasm_bg.wasm')"
scripts.build:ts: npm run typecheck && npm run build:worker && npm run build:app
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
